info.title: FilingLens API
info.description:
Answers analyst questions over SEC filings with citations you can check.

**Keys.** Send `X-API-Key` on every route except `/healthz` and `/readyz`. `API_KEY` opens the
normal routes. `ADMIN_API_KEY` opens every route, and it is the only key for the admin routes
under `/v1/ingest-jobs`. A missing or unknown key gets 401; `API_KEY` on an admin route gets 403.
Only servers call this API: any request with an `Origin` header gets 403, on every route.

**Errors.** Every error is an RFC 9457 problem (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code`.
429 carries `Retry-After`, `RateLimit-Limit` and `RateLimit-Remaining`. 503 carries `Retry-After`
only when waiting helps: `overloaded` (too many answers in progress, a busy reranker, or a broker
that refused a job or could not be reached), and `ai_unavailable` when today's AI budget is used
up (until 00:00 UTC), the budget cannot be checked, or the model providers are rate limited. An
`ai_unavailable` without `Retry-After` does not clear by waiting: AI is switched off on this
server, or the last model refused the key, has no credits left or was retired. GraphQL's `answer`
reports its limits as errors with `extensions.code`, without headers. GraphQL takes POST only.

**Pages.** List routes take `limit` (at most 100) and an opaque `cursor`. Send back `next_cursor`
until it is null.

get.description:
Hybrid search over the text of indexed filings. Either key.

Vector and full-text matches are fused and reranked. The cursor holds the last hit's score
and chunk id and the index version, so later pages come from the same index; once the index
changes (a new embedding model), a cursor gets 409 and the search starts again without one.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Absent when waiting will not help: AI is switched off, or the last model refused the key, has no credits or was retired.

400.description: Unusable cursor (invalid_input). Start again without one.

409.description: The cursor came from a search index that has since changed (conflict). Search again without a cursor.

post.description:
Answer a question from the filings, citing a chunk or an XBRL fact. Either key.

At most 10 a minute per key, and 30 s each (then 502).

post.description:
POST /v1/answers as Server-Sent Events. Either key; shares the answers limits.

`delta` events carry the answer's text as the model writes it, then one `completed` event
carries the whole answer after validation. The two agree unless validation rewrote the draft,
and then the completed answer has warnings and replaces the streamed text. An error after the
stream has started arrives as a `failed` event with a problem, and so does a stream still
running after 30 s.

200.description: Server-Sent Events, each carrying one AnswerEvent as JSON.

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: True when retrieval skipped the reranker after a timeout.

refused.title: Refused
refused.description: True when FilingLens declined: out of scope, a company it does not track, a fiscal year with no 10-K yet, or no evidence relevant enough. `answer` says why.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Validation notes, such as sentences removed because a citation or an amount did not check out. A streamed answer with warnings replaces the draft its deltas carried.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: Exactly one source: chunk_id for filing text, fact_id for an XBRL fact.
